root.label: Senators demand transparent accounting of Iran war costs

events.label: Senators demand transparent accounting of Iran war costs

slots.name: senators signing letter
slots.sentence: Last month, 45 Senate Democrats and one independent wrote an open letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth demanding transparent accounting of the war’s costs.

slots.name: higher consumer costs
slots.sentence: They argued that a “detailed breakdown” of the costs was necessary before Congress considers further supplemental funding.

slots.name: other higher costs
slots.sentence: at least another $60 billion in higher costs for things like groceries, mortgages, and plane tickets as a result of the war,” the senators wrote.
